mapper.select: SELECT t.id FROM xxl_job_registry AS t WHERE t.update_time < (CAST(#{nowTime} AS timestamp) - #{timeout} * INTERVAL '1 second')
SELECT FROM xxl_job_registry AS t WHERE t.update_time > (CAST(#{nowTime} AS timestamp) - #{timeout} * INTERVAL '1 second')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xxl_job_registry( registry_group , registry_key , registry_value, update_time, executor_protocol) VALUES( #{registryGroup} , #{registryKey} , #{registryValue}, #{updateTime}, #{executorProtocol}) ON CONFLICT (registry_group, registry_key, registry_value) DO UPDATE SET update_time = #{updateTime}, executor_protocol = #{executorProtocol}
mapper.select: SELECT executor_protocol FROM xxl_job_registry WHERE registry_group = 'EXECUTOR' AND registry_key = #{appname} AND registry_value IN (#{address}, #{alternativeAddress}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN registry_value = #{address} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, update_time DESC LIMIT 1
